items.briefing:
The FBI is investigating a service that exposed over 153 million drivers' licence records, which may include Australian residents who have interacted with US-based organisations. Separately, ransomware groups are increasingly recruiting insiders — current or former employees — to gain access to systems, making it important to report any suspicious contact from outside parties offering payment for access. The Actuaries Institute and UTS have also published new AI risk guidance tailored for Australian financial services organisations.

If someone contacts you offering money in exchange for access to your workplace systems, report it to your manager or IT security team immediately — do not engage.
